notes: Native GTK4 AGPC View 0.1.0-6 for amd64, built and GUI-checked by canonical main CI. Local manages this computer and now provides CI-source inspection, validation and explicit credential synchronization. Mesh requires Account browser SSO at account.ypcloud.com and adds selected SIP and ss-webos Live key management, native provider-binding setup, import/replacement and separately gated retirement. Teal Local and violet Mesh styles follow light, dark and high-contrast themes. Native checks cover the authentication gate; successful human sign-in remains separate live evidence. Requires the signed agpc-key-manager 0.1.0-2 and Voice key owner dependency, the pinned existing Voice runtime, native Zenity authentication, an approved CI identity, AGPC Mesh >=3.0.0-3 and <4, GTK4 >=4.8 and glibc >=2.39. Provider setup and retirement require an ephemeral Admin API credential through the native prompt. WebOS activation additionally requires its reviewed owner OCI/PD promotion and existing Account system-admin role; this GUI release does not deploy that service. Run agpc-view as the desktop user. This standalone release does not change Core/All installers, enable Mesh RUN, or establish runtime readiness. Verify MANIFEST.json.asc and SHA256SUMS.asc with the established MoteBus archive key before installing.
